# Cormorant Garamond

Cormorant Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL.txt.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cormorantgaramond

The italic variable font is subset to Latin and punctuation, converted to WOFF2, and embedded as a data URI in font.css. The original font is not changed in the source archive.
